speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) whether IMDA places a limit on the number of mailboxes a postman has to cover each day; (b) whether there are regulations in place to safeguard the working conditions of postmen; and (c) how does IMDA plan to support SingPost in adopting technology or redesigning jobs to improve accuracy and efficiency of mail sorting and delivery to ease existing workloads.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Postmen who work overtime are given overtime pay.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The Member asked about regulations to safeguard the working conditions of postmen.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: I am told that over the past few years, SingPost has increased the postmen’s salary and that MOM has not received any valid salary-related complaints over the last five years.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: IMDA is fully supportive of SingPost's on-going efforts to adopt technology and redesign jobs.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: IMDA has also stated that it would be conducting a full investigation into the incident where the postman was dismissed for throwing away mail.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can the Minister share what the scope of the investigation is and, based on this investigation, if SingPost will be further reviewing the workload of postmen and postwomen?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I do not have the details as yet.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: But once we are finished with the investigations, we will communicate the outcome to SingPost.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: And if there are further remedial measures that SingPost will have to take, we will ask SingPost to comply with them.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: At the end of the day, as I have mentioned earlier, we control the outcome through our Quality of Service standards and, if there are lapses in SingPost, we will have to deal with it accordingly.
